pages.text: Hope in Christ 🕊️ Church Motto “Growing in truth. Living in love. Glorifying God.” — Inspired by Ephesians 4:15 🙌 About Us Welcome to Emmanuel Farm Baptist Church (EFBC) — a place where faith is cultivated, truth is spoken in love, and God's holiness is glorified. Established on January 5, 2025, in the Pine Bluff area, EFBC began as a humble gathering of Burmese Chin believers, many of whom are hardworking chicken farmers. Rooted in both our cultural heritage and spiritual calling, we now serve the community from our home in Star City, Arkansas. We are more than a church — we are a family united by grace, committed to worship, and anchored in the Word of God. Our gatherings are centered on one purpose: to worship the Lord and glorify His holiness in every aspect of our lives. Our guiding verse, Ephesians 4:15, calls us to “speak the truth in love,” growing together in Christ who is the head of the Church. This truth shapes our worship, our fellowship, and our mission. Our Mission Our Vision Our Values ✝️ Mission Statement At Emmanuel Farm Baptist Church, our mission is to cultivate a Christ-centered community rooted in truth, love, and holiness. As Burmese Chin believers, we gather to worship God, glorify His name, and grow together in spiritual maturity — speaking the truth in love and building up the body of Christ. 🌟 Our Vision To be a Spirit-led church where truth is spoken in love , faith is cultivated , and God’s holiness is glorified — transforming lives, strengthening families, and building a Christ-centered community that reflects the heart of Jesus in every generation. We envision Emmanuel Farm Baptist Church as a beacon of hope for the Burmese Chin community and beyond, where cultural heritage and biblical truth walk hand in hand to proclaim the Gospel with boldness and compassion. 🛡️ Our Core Values Grounded in Ephesians 4:15 , we commit to: Truth in Love We speak and live the truth of God’s Word with grace, humility, and compassion. Christ-Centered Worship Our gatherings exist to glorify God’s holiness and exalt Jesus as Lord over all. Spiritual Growth We grow together in faith, maturity, and unity — becoming more like Christ in every area of life. Cultural Honor We celebrate our Chin heritage as a gift from God, using it to strengthen our witness and deepen our fellowship. Servant Leadership We lead by serving, following the example of Christ in humility and love. Community & Fellowship We build authentic relationships that reflect the love of Christ and support one another in every season. Mission & Outreach We share the Gospel boldly — in our neighborhoods, workplaces, and across cultures — so that others may know the truth and love of Jesus.
